test_resolve_qwen_runtime_credentials: test the Qwen OAuth credential resolver that reads tokens, refreshes expiring ones, and returns runtime API credentials
test_refresh_qwen_cli_tokens: test the Qwen OAuth token refresh function that POSTs to the token endpoint and persists new tokens to disk
test_get_qwen_auth_status: test the Qwen authentication status checker that returns logged-in state and API key from the local credentials file
test_read_qwen_cli_tokens: test reading Qwen CLI OAuth tokens from the local credentials file with error handling for missing or invalid files
test_save_qwen_cli_tokens: test saving Qwen CLI OAuth tokens to the local credentials file with secure file permissions
